name: AllMyMeetings API
description: AllMyMeetings exposes calendar operations via an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and receives real-time change notifications from calendar providers via webhook endpoints. Primary programmatic access is through the MCP JSON-RPC endpoint documented here; use an MCP-aware client (Claude Desktop, Perplexity, OpenClaw, etc.) to consume it.
